atomic.decision: Declared fields, aliases, and instance field maps expose the ordinary public model.
Scalar conversion and representation round-trip through one schema.
Unknown-field exclude, include, and reject policies remain distinct.
Defaults, load-only, dump-only, and external names keep directional meaning.
Multiple validators preserve all public messages after conversion.
Nested lists, fixed tuples, and typed leaves compose conversion.
Load and dump processors surround field work in public order.
Partial loading suppresses only selected required fields and retains valid_data.
Version declarations are immutable, reopenable, and predecessor bound.
Graph operation identities converge exactly and reject conflicting reuse.
A migration step captures rename, default, and drop transformations without mutable aliases.
A unique directed version path is planned in stable step order.
A load transaction fixes ordered unique indices and a target schema version.
One staged document migrates before ordinary schema conversion and becomes durable.
Hierarchical error provenance retains typed coordinates and stable descendant order.
Nested process events are monotonic, scoped, and closed last-in-first-out.

composition.decision: Nested projections and external names agree in both directions.
Nested collection failures preserve indices and successful sibling values.
Collection processors surround many-mode field work once.
Custom fields and schema validation compose across load and dump.
Multi-version predecessor topology is complete, namespace isolated, and cycle rejecting.
Reopening a graph preserves definitions, operations, and independent schema namespaces.
A conflicting declaration or connection leaves all prior graph views unchanged.
A multi-hop plan transforms documents in path order while preserving unrelated keys and inputs.
Shortest-path planning distinguishes unique, identity, unreachable, and ambiguous routes.
Rename collisions and contradictory transformations fail without partial document or graph changes.
Staging observes migrated keys in ordinary schema processors and stores converted target values.
Validation rejection becomes durable provenance and valid sibling data rather than escaping the transaction.
Exact staging replay converges while changed replay, unknown index, stale record, and premature seal fail closed.
Nested list and field errors retain integer and string coordinates through the durable record.
Independent validator messages remain attached to the migrated target field with version provenance.
Dotted partial paths suppress only missing requirements while supplied nested failures and valid siblings remain visible.
Provenance ordering and record digests survive reopen and reject changed public identity.
Parent and child load processors appear in actual nested execution order inside one trace.
Migration events precede target-schema hooks and converted completion for each staged index.
Expected-index order and per-record trace order remain distinct and stable under out-of-order staging.
A failed nested load closes trace scopes while retaining all pre-failure processing events.
A sealed transaction can be prepared while remaining invisible to stream readers.
Publication exposes accepted values and rejected provenance from one generation atomically.
Stream generations, exact replay, conflicting reuse, and reopen preserve independent publication identity.
Dynamically constructed nested schemas round-trip typed records.
Callable recursive schemas terminate under projection while preserving visible descendants.
Prepared and published generations recover to their exact durable visibility state.
A strict coordinator run crosses planning, migration, conversion, sealing, and verification.
Interrupted execution resumes expected work exactly once without changing earlier records or trace order.
Partial execution publishes accepted rows and complete rejection provenance as one terminal lineage.
Nested hooks, migrated fields, provenance paths, and public records agree across one multi-version batch.
Moved durable state reopens coherently while wrong-owner and forged lineage attempts fail without replacing current publication.
